personalInfo.bio: Passionate full-stack developer specializing in modern web technologies and 3D graphics. Currently studying at IIT Indore with hands-on experience in MERN stack, Three.js, and building immersive web experiences.

planets.name: Head of Web Dev - Astronomy Club

projects.name: IMMERSIVE 3D PORTFOLIO
projects.shortDescription: Interactive space-themed portfolio featuring 3D spacecraft models, holographic UI panels, and explorable solar system navigation built with React Three Fiber and Three.js.
keyFeatures: 3D Spacecraft Models - Detailed GLTF models with realistic textures, animations including launch sequences and docking mechanics
Explorable Solar System - Interactive planet navigation system allowing users to explore different sections (About, Skills, Projects, Contact) through space travel
Holographic UI Panels - Futuristic interface with smooth transitions, animated content reveals, and gesture-safe touch controls

projects.name: AIRBNB REPLICA
projects.shortDescription: Full-featured rental marketplace platform with complete booking management, user authentication, and interactive mapping functionality.
keyFeatures: Secure Authentication System - Passport.js-based session authentication with user registration and login
Complete Listing Management - Users can create, edit, and delete property listings with image uploads via Cloudinary
Review & Rating System - Authenticated users can leave reviews and ratings on listings

projects.name: GAMING CLUB WEBSITE - IIT INDORE
projects.shortDescription: Official Gaming Club website featuring tournament management, event registration, and member directory serving the IIT Indore gaming community.
keyFeatures: Tournament Management System - Live tournament registration portal with active, upcoming, and past tournament tracking
Event Registration Portal - Integrated sign-up system allowing students to register for tournaments directly through the website
Dynamic Event Gallery - Photo gallery showcasing past gaming events and competitions with responsive image grids

projects.name: ASTRONOMY CLUB WEBSITE - IIT INDORE
projects.shortDescription: Official Astronomy Club website showcasing research projects, astronomy news, and club activities with an immersive space-themed user experience.
keyFeatures: Interactive Loading Experience - Custom 3D Earth rotation loader creating an engaging entry animation
Research Projects Showcase - Dedicated section highlighting ongoing astronomy and astrophysics research initiatives
Live Astronomy News Feed - Curated news section featuring latest updates in astronomy and astrophysics

projects.name: EDUCONNECT - ACADEMIC PORTAL
projects.shortDescription: Comprehensive academic management system featuring dual role-based portals for students and faculty with real-time scheduling and resource management.
keyFeatures: Dual Role Authentication - Separate login portals and dashboards for students and faculty with secure session management
Dynamic Timetable Management - Real-time class schedules with next-class indicators, weekly views, and automatic updates
Resource Management System - Faculty can upload and organize educational materials including documents, presentations, videos, and quizzes

projects.name: SIMON SAYS GAME
projects.shortDescription: Interactive memory game built with vanilla JavaScript featuring dynamic pattern generation, progressive difficulty levels, and engaging visual feedback.
keyFeatures: Pattern Recognition - Generates random color sequences that players must memorize and repeat
Progressive Difficulty - Each successful round adds a new color to the sequence, increasing challenge
Visual & Audio Feedback - Colorful animations and sound effects for enhanced user engagement

projects.name: SPOTIFY CLONE
projects.shortDescription: Pixel-perfect frontend clone of Spotify's web interface built with HTML and CSS, replicating the music streaming platform's design and layout.
keyFeatures: Authentic UI Replication - Faithful recreation of Spotify's interface including sidebar, player controls, and content sections
Responsive Grid Layouts - CSS Grid and Flexbox implementation for playlist and album displays
Custom Styling - Hover effects, transitions, and interactive elements matching Spotify's design language

projects.name: AMAZON CLONE
projects.shortDescription: Frontend replica of Amazon's e-commerce interface showcasing product layouts, navigation systems, and responsive design principles using pure HTML and CSS.
keyFeatures: E-commerce Layout - Complete homepage structure with header, navigation bar, product sections, and footer
Product Card System - Grid-based product displays with images, titles, prices, and call-to-action buttons
Navigation Bar - Multi-level navigation menu replicating Amazon's category system
